items.description: Come join the ancestors and us on Monday, November 2, 2026, from 6 p.m. to 8 p.m. for a celebration of Día de Muertos (Day of the Dead) complete with a mariachi band, family altars, tacos and tamales for purchase, and a cash/credit bar. Free to the community. Sponsored by the McMullan/O'Connor Fund.100 Men Hall celebrates the Latin community by converting the Hall into a Mexican mercado complete with paper hangings, a community altar, mariachi live music, Mexican food, and more. You are welcome to bring a photo or memento of your loved one(s) to put on the altar. The vibe is authentic Mexican.Day of the Dead celebrates ancestors with All Souls' Day, a holiday in Mexico dating back to the early 1500s. items.title: Sebastian Bach With Slaughter
items.description: With an inimitable presence as loud as his instantly identifiable voice, Sebastian Bach has left a San Andreas Fault-sized imprint on music, theater, film, television, and culture. Moreover, his influence only continues to magnify.He has penned and voiced some of the most iconic anthems in rock history, crafting a catalog highlighted by generational hits such as “18 and Life,” “I Remember You,” “Youth Gone Wild”, ”Slave To The Grind”, “Wasted Time,” and “Monkey Business,” to name a few. He has made history as “the first heavy metal singer on Broadway” with a now legendary turn in Jekyll & Hyde: The Musical, in addition to leading roles in The Rocky Horror Picture Show and Jesus Christ Superstar. He has appeared in dozens of television series and films, ranging from Trailer Park Boys and Robot Chicken to SpongeBob SquarePants, The Masked Singer, and Hell’s Kitchen. Speaking to his versatility, he’s the rare force of nature who can duet with Axl Rose and reprise a seven-season recurring role on Gilmore Girls.1990 Slaughter hit radio, MTV, and the U.S. touring circuit like a tornado- coming seemingly out of nowhere to roll through everything in its path and turn it upside down. Touring the world with bands that they loved, Kiss, Ozzy, and others, meant the good times were just a song away, and their first hit single, "Up All Night," certainly fit into that mold; their second chart-topper, "Fly To The Angels," was more representative of the spirituality and awareness that goes into most of the band's music and lyrics. But never were SLAUGHTER more accurately represented than live onstage in front of their legions of devoted fans over the last ten years.Slaughter has shown that with perseverance and sheer talent, a band can survive and win over fans' support, regardless of what others may say about the quality of their music. What's most important is that their music is still here and the vast majority of critics who panned them in the past are not, and that's as good as gold! *Image Courtesy: IP Casino Resort Spa

items.title: Theatre in the Pass Presents "The Nutcracker"
items.description: Just in time for the holidays, Theatre in the Pass is happy to announce that it will present the dramatic production of The Nutcracker from November 12-15! This version of The Nutcracker, adapted by June Walker Rogers and performed as a stage play, is a magical Christmas story about a young girl named Clara who receives a beautiful nutcracker doll as a gift on Christmas Eve. That night, the Nutcracker comes to life and leads Clara through a series of adventures in strange lands as he battles against the evil Mouse King and his army to regain his throne. The next morning, Clara finds the Nutcracker gone. Then Godfather returns with his nephew, who looks just like the prince. Was it a dream?Join us on a magical journey through the Land of Snow and the Kingdom of Sweets, where we meet the Sugar Plum Fairy, the Snow Queen, and a multitude of characters. The story celebrates the magic of Christmas, imagination, and the wonder of childhood. This production, which includes several Nutcracker Ballet selections, has a cast of children, teens, and adults.The Nutcracker is produced by special arrangement with The Dramatic Publishing Company of Woodstock, Illinois.The play is directed by Paige Ladner and Stephen Scott and assisted by Kay Benton, Alex Bosarge, and Marcella Hoffman.Performances will be held at Randolph Community Center (315 Clark Ave.) Thursday – Saturday, November 12-14, at 7 p.m. and Sunday, November 13, at 2 p.m. Season Passes, tickets, and sponsorships are available on our website https://passmainstreet.com/theatreinthepass-2/ and at https://theatreinthepass.ludus.com/, as well as on Facebook at https://www.facebook.com/theatreinthepass/.Theatre in the Pass (formerly the Pass Christian Theatre Project) was formed in 2014 when the City of Pass Christian offered a group of local volunteers the auditorium of the Randolph Community Center as a home for a new community theatre. Theatre in the Pass is a project of Pass Christian Main Street Foundation, a 501(c)3 non-profit.For more information, contact Gail Trahan at gail@theatreinthepassms.org.

items.title: The Stray Cats at Beau Rivage
items.description: The band that put Rockabilly music back on the record charts will perform at Beau Rivage with special guest The Chin Chins!The STRAY CATS, the band that put Rockabilly music back on the record charts in the early '80s, scored several big hits on both sides of the Atlantic thanks to a striking visual 1950s style brought "up to date" with exaggerated pompadours and colorful tattoos, as well as genuine musical chops that evoked the best players of rockabilly's original heyday. Formed by guitarist/vocalist Brian Setzer, upright bass player Lee Rocker, and drummer Slim Jim Phantom in the Long Island town of Massapequa, NY, in 1979, the trio shared a love for Rockabilly music. After banging around New York for a few months, in the summer of 1980, and seeing a pompadoured kid on the cover of UK magazine NME, they hopped a plane to London, where a rockabilly revival movement was just beginning to emerge. Their massive hits and videos include "Runaway Boys," "Rock This Town," "Stray Cat Strut," "(She's) Sexy + 17," and "I Won't Stand in Your Way."

items.title: Matt Mathews: Not What I Ordered Tour
items.description: Matt Mathews is a comedian, singer/songwriter, and unapologetic trailblazer whose raw honesty, razor-sharp wit, and unmistakable Southern charm have made him one of comedy’s fastest-rising stars. Born and raised in Birmingham, Alabama, Mathews first captured national attention during the pandemic with his viral “farm chore” videos, turning everyday chaos, unfiltered storytelling, and authentic humor into a social media phenomenon. Today, he has built a devoted audience of more than 15 million followers and generated over a billion views across platforms.What started as a playful escape from his full-time career as a boudoir photographer quickly evolved into a breakout comedy career. After performing stand-up for the first time in 2022, Mathews rapidly went from small clubs to sold-out theaters and arenas across the country. His wildly successful Boujee On A Budget Tour sold more than 250,000 tickets and included multiple performances at Nashville’s historic Ryman Auditorium as well as his first-ever arena show in his hometown of Birmingham.Now, Mathews returns to the stage with his newest tour, Not What I Ordered — a hilarious and deeply personal look at life not going according to plan. Through stories about relationships, family, fame, farm life, mental health, and the chaos of everyday living, Mathews delivers the kind of brutally honest comedy that has made fans feel like they’ve known him forever. Equal parts outrageous, heartfelt, and wildly relatable, the tour showcases his unique ability to turn life’s messiest moments into unforgettable comedy.Mathews’ work is rooted in his real-life experiences as a farmer, barrel racer, entrepreneur, proud Alabamian, and openly gay entertainer navigating the industry with authenticity and humor. His perspective has earned him recognition from Deadline, which named him among the “Future of Comedy,” as well as praise from The Advocate for the path he continues to carve in entertainment.

items.description: Celebrate the season at the Gulfport Harbor Lights Winter Festival, one of the Coast’s most cherished holiday traditions. Gather your family and friends, wear your holiday best, and make Downtown Biloxi part of your Coastal Mississippi Christmas tradition this season. items.title: Bohemian Celebration with the Premier Party for "Bohemian by the Bay"
items.description: It's a celebration! - the book launch party for Bohemian by the Bay, by writer/designer Valorie Hart and photographer Sara Essex Bradley on Tuesday, December 15th from 6:00 - 7:30 PM at 301 East Scenic. Dress in your bohemian finest as you attend. In a tribute to the enchanting Mississippi Gulf Coast, writer and designer Valorie Hart and photographer Sara Essex Bradley bid you to explore twenty of the region's very best abodes and meet the inspiring free spirits who live in them. A complement to their book Bohemian Soul (Rizzoli, 2024), which is an homage to New Orleans's unique interiors, Bohemian by the Bay is a jaunt down to the coast.In the bohemian communities of the Mississippi Gulf Coast--known for its wide-armed welcome, resilience, and charm--originality flourishes and the bon vivants, the mavericks, and artists of every medium make their homes. It's no surprise then that these living spaces are filled with fine art, an eclectic blend of antiques and hand-me-down furnishings, and so much heart. From the architecture to the beloved tchotchkes, crossing each threshold is a unique experience, and Bohemian by the Bay is an invitation to wander the halls, pull up a chair at the table, relax on the porch, and see for yourself the magic of the Southern coast.

items.title: Laying of the Wreaths
items.description: Join us on December 19, 2026, at 10 a.m. CST at Biloxi National Cemetery as Wreaths Across America gathers to remember and honor our nation's veterans through the placement of Remembrance wreaths on the graves of our fallen heroes. Following the ceremony, volunteers will help lay wreaths throughout the cemetery while taking a moment to speak each veteran's name aloud, ensuring their service and sacrifice are never forgotten.Community members of all ages and backgrounds are welcome to participate. To receive important event updates and details about the cemetery, all volunteers are encouraged to register in advance. During the wreath placement, please help ensure that every participant has the opportunity to place a wreath and follow the guidance of location coordinators regarding where and how wreaths should be placed.Volunteers willing to assist with cleanup after the ceremony are especially appreciated. If you are interested in helping, please check in with a location coordinator on the day of the event.You can also support the mission by sponsoring a wreath to help ensure as many veterans as possible are honored. Invite your family and friends to join you for this meaningful community tradition as we come together to remember, honor, and teach future generations about the sacrifices made by our nation's heroes.Thank you for supporting Biloxi National Cemetery and Wreaths Across America. We look forward to honoring our veterans with you!

items.title: Bachman-Turner Overdrive
items.description: In 2023, Randy Bachman revived Bachman-Turner Overdrive, the legendary rock n’ roll band behind worldwide hits such as “Takin’ Care Of Business” and “You Ain’t Seen Nothin’ Yet”. After headlining successful tours in Canada and the US in 2024 and 2025, BTO continues its momentum with the No Speed Limit Tour in 2027, following Bachman’s acclaimed outing with former bandmate Burton Cummings as The Guess Who.Led by Bachman, BTO has recently revamped its lineup. “BTO has truly become a family band again,” Bachman exclaims. “My son, Tal Bachman on guitar, my daughter-in-law, KoKo Bachman on drums, and our friends Lance Lapointe on bass and Brent Knudsen on guitar. We sound better than ever. We’re playing all the hits, as well as diving deep into the album cuts, and the response from fans has been incredible. The BTO sound is BACK!”Bachman has become a legendary figure in the rock and roll world through his talents as a guitarist, songwriter, performer and producer. Bachman has earned over 120 gold and platinum album/singles awards around the world. His songwriting has garnered him the coveted #1 spot on radio playlists in over 20 countries and over the course of his career he has sold over 40 million records. Randy’s songs have been recorded by a broad range of artists and have been placed in dozens of TV shows, films and commercials. Impressively, his music has provided a veritable soundtrack of the last thirty years of popular music.Bachman first scored success with his band The Guess Who in 1965 performing the song “Shakin' All Over.” The Guess Who went on an unprecedented run of 5 singles that each sold a million copies, all the product of the gold-plated Randy Bachman-Burton Cummings songwriting team. By 1970, The Guess Who had sold more records than the entire Canadian recording industry to that point, even outselling the Beatles that year. Their hits included “These Eyes,” “Laughing,” “Undun,” “No Time,” “No Sugar Tonight,” and “American Woman.”Randy's success with Bachman-Turner Overdrive would eclipse his earlier triumphs and give him yet another run at the pop music charts. Monstrous hits for the band included “Let it Ride,” “Roll on Down the Highway,” “Takin' Care of Business,” “Hey You,” “Looking Out for #1,” “Four Wheel Drive” and “You Ain't Seen Nothin' Yet” which reached #1 in over 20 countries.Randy's career has been built upon his unstoppable drive to work at creating music. The BTO legacy lives on, promising unforgettable performances and a continued impact on the ever-evolving rock landscape.

items.title: Arts Alive! 2027
items.description: Experience one of the Coast's most beloved arts celebrations at Arts Alive! 2027, Hancock County's premier arts festival! Join artists, makers, musicians, vendors, and art enthusiasts for a weekend filled with creativity, culture, live entertainment, and community in the heart of Bay St. Louis.Held throughout the Historic Depot Arts District along Blaize Avenue, Arts Alive! takes place on the newly renovated grounds surrounding the historic Bay St. Louis L&N Train Depot and the Mamie Hillery Arts Center, creating a vibrant setting for visitors to discover local and regional talent.Event DetailsDates: Saturday, March 20 & Sunday, March 21, 2027Time: 10 AM to 5 PM dailyAdmission: Open to the publicCelebrate Art, Music, Creativity & CommunityArts Alive! invites visitors to explore:Fine art and handcrafted works from local and regional artistsArtisan vendors and makersLive music and entertainmentInteractive creative experiencesFamily-friendly activitiesFood and refreshmentsThe thriving arts community of Bay St. LouisWhether you're an art collector, a casual browser, or simply looking for a fun weekend on the Mississippi Gulf Coast, Arts Alive! offers something for everyone.A Rich Arts TraditionFounded in 2004 as a studio tour featuring members of The Arts, Hancock County, Arts Alive! has grown from a small community event into one of South Mississippi's signature arts festivals.As the festival expanded over the years, it outgrew its original downtown footprint. Following the establishment of the Mamie Hillery Arts Center, made possible through the generous support of local art patron Mamie Hillery, The Arts, Hancock County found a permanent home in the heart of Bay St. Louis' Historic Depot District. Today, Arts Alive! proudly calls this thriving arts destination home, showcasing the creativity and culture that make Hancock County unique.Calling All Artists, Vendors & MakersApplications are now open for:Visual ArtistsArtisans & MakersCraft VendorsCreative BusinessesMakerSpace ParticipantsRegister now and save! items.title: Brad Williams: The Big and Small Tour
items.description: Brad Williams’ latest stand-up special, Live On Short Street, is now streaming on YouTube, continuing his run as one of the most dynamic and in-demand comedians in the world. His previous special, Starfish, went viral with over 9 million views, cementing his place as one of the sharpest, most original comedic voices working today. Currently selling out theaters around the globe, Brad delivers high-energy performances that blend personal storytelling, razor-sharp punchlines, and an irresistible charisma that leaves audiences on their feet. He also co-hosts the fast-rising podcast Heightened Babble alongside fellow comic JB Ball, where the two break down outrageous news, life on the road, and the absurd realities of the comedy world.He first took the mic as a teenager and never looked back, racking up major TV appearances on The Tonight Show, Jimmy Kimmel Live, and Dave Attell’s Comedy Underground, while building a run of hit specials including Showtime’s Fun Size and Daddy Issues. He has also appeared on Netflix’s The Degenerates and Comedy Central’s This Is Not Happening.Beyond the stage, Brad co-created and co-hosted the long-running hit podcast About Last Night with Adam Ray, a fixture on the podcast charts throughout its five-year run. He’s also been featured on some of the most influential comedy platforms in the world, including The Joe Rogan Experience, Your Mom’s House, This Past Weekend with Theo Von, Something’s Burning, Are You Garbage, and TigerBelly; introducing him to millions of listeners and further fueling his sold-out global tours.As an actor, Brad has showcased his comedic range on TV series such as Legit, Sam & Cat, Mind of Mencia, and Deadbeat, as well as in films including Little Evil, Christopher Guest’s Mascots, and Reno 911: It’s A Wonderful Heist. He also made history as the first stand-up comedian in Cirque du Soleil’s 30-year history to headline a production, leading Mad Apple in Las Vegas to rave reviews. He recently appeared in the highly anticipated film Spinal Tap 2, which premiered in September 2025.Robin Williams once called him “Prozac with a head,” and it’s easy to see why—Brad doesn’t just tell jokes; he ignites a room. With fearless and deeply personal observations on disability, relationships, sex, and race, he continues to captivate audiences worldwide and prove that no topic—and no audience—is beyond his reach.

items.title: CLASH Coastal Mississippi Triathlon
items.description: Get ready for an action-packed weekend as CLASH Endurance Coastal Mississippi Triathlon returns to the beautiful Mississippi Gulf Coast on April 2-4, 2027!Athletes from across the United States and around the world will gather in Gulfport, Mississippi, to compete in one of the region's most scenic endurance events.Hosted at Jones Park Pavilion, adjacent to Mississippi Aquarium, this exciting triathlon showcases the best of Coastal Mississippi with stunning waterfront views, white-sand beaches, and a vibrant community atmosphere. Whether you're competing, supporting a participant, or simply looking for an exciting sporting event to experience, CLASH Coastal Mississippi delivers an unforgettable race weekend!Race HighlightsScenic Open-Water SwimAthletes will begin with a protected saltwater swim course in the Gulf of America, located near the newly rebuilt Gulfport Municipal Marina. The calm waters and picturesque Coastal setting create an ideal environment for competitors of all levels.Fast Coastal Bike CourseThe traffic-controlled cycling course takes athletes east along Beach Boulevard (US-90) toward Biloxi, offering a flat, fast route with spectacular views of the Mississippi Gulf Coast.Beautiful Waterfront RunThe run course winds through Gulfport's scenic Coastal neighborhoods, where participants are greeted by enthusiastic spectators and the warm Southern hospitality for which Coastal Mississippi is known.A World-Class Race SettingSet against the backdrop of the Gulfport Marina & Yacht Club, historic fishing and shrimp boats, and 26 miles of the world's longest man-made white-sand beach, CLASH Coastal Mississippi combines elite competition with a true Gulf Coast experience.Compete or CheerReady to challenge yourself? Register to compete and experience one of the premier triathlon events on the Coast. Athletes of all experience levels are welcome. Not racing? Come out and support athletes as they swim, bike, and run their way through one of Mississippi's most scenic sporting events.From endurance competition and waterfront views to community spirit and Coastal hospitality, CLASH Endurance Coastal Mississippi Triathlon is a must-attend event for athletes, families, and sports fans visiting Coastal Mississippi.

items.title: Coastal Journey Quilt Show presented by Bay Oaks Quilt Guild
items.description: Bay Oaks Quilt Guild is hosting their biennial quilt show on Friday, May 7th and Saturday, May 8th at St. Rose de Lima Holy Spirit Center, 301 South Necaise Avenue, Bay St. Louis, MS 39520. Friday hours are 9 am until 6 pm; Saturday's are 9 am until 5 pm. Admission is $5; children under 12 free. Bay Oaks is based in Kiln, MS, but pulls members from most cities on the Mississippi Gulf Coast as well as Picayune and Hattiesburg, MS and Slidell, LA. It is affiliated with the Gulf States Quilting Association. Our quilt show includes over 100 quilts featuring various techniques. Visitors will have a chance to vote for Viewers' Choice award. There will be quilting demonstrations & door prizes both days. Guild members are also sponsoring a boutique, with plenty of hand-made items for purchase. There will also be two coast Quilt Shop vendors to shop. Opportunity quilt tickets can be purchased for $1 each or 6 for $5. The winning ticket will be drawn on Saturday, May 8th at 4 pm; winner need not be present.
